title: Transfer and Review
status: New proposed Lesson 03 production script, 2026-10-29. No new animation or narration in this handoff.
learningOutcome: Select a relevant listening or response move in a new context, without applying a rigid sequence or implying assessed mastery.

scenario.task: Plan a short, useful guide for new club members.
knownFacts: The guide should be easy to read and useful to a newcomer.
scenario.laterAuthoredInformation: Activity-group names are identified only when Maya gives that information in d003.

blocks.title: Choose a Move Before the Model

L03.S07.c001.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c001.text: Try the same listening approach in a new discussion. A group is planning a short guide for new club members. They want it to be easy to read and useful to someone who does not already know how the club works. No version has been chosen.
L03.S07.c001.visualEn: Introduce a fresh blank guide with task cards. Do not reuse a finished workshop outcome or display a published guide.
L03.S07.c001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c001.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.d001.speaker: maya
L03.S07.d001.text: A shorter guide would be quicker to read, but some new members may not know the terms.
L03.S07.d001.visualEn: Brief cast example with the statement visible in full. The concern is terminology, not evidence that any guide has failed.
L03.S07.d001.anchorHint: some new members may not know the terms
L03.S07.d001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.d001.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L03.S07.c002.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c002.text: Separate the benefit Maya suggests from the concern she raises. Do not turn the possibility that some new members may not know the terms into a claim that they cannot understand anything. Do not assume she wants a longer guide unless she says so.
L03.S07.c002.visualEn: Move the exact phrase some new members and the word may into a scope highlight. The word some qualifies the people, not a newly assumed subset of terms. Keep a hypothetical Longer guide interpretation outside the evidence area.
L03.S07.c002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c002.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.c003.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c003.text: What would be useful to say next? You could check your understanding, clarify an uncertainty, support a specific point, or add a relevant suggestion. Choose one move that fits this moment and form a short reply privately.
L03.S07.c003.visualEn: Present optional resources at equal emphasis with no selection. Show a genuinely blank response area and hide the model.
L03.S07.c003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c003.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.d002.speaker: learner
L03.S07.d002.text: Which terms do you think need a short explanation for new members?
L03.S07.d002.visualEn: Show a separate authored model frame. This question does not claim all unfamiliar terms are already known.
L03.S07.d002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.d002.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L03.S07.d003.speaker: maya
L03.S07.d003.text: The names of our activity groups, for example. A new member might not know what each one does.
L03.S07.d003.visualEn: Add this information only now, as Maya provides it in the fictional exchange. It must not appear as established fact in the earlier task.
L03.S07.d003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.d003.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L03.S07.c004.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c004.text: The question makes the uncertainty more specific. The group can now discuss how to explain those names. That does not settle the length or design of the guide. Another relevant reply might also have helped; this is one authored example.
L03.S07.c004.visualEn: Connect the exact question to the new information, leaving length and design visibly open. No winner or mastered badge.
L03.S07.c004.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c004.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.c005.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c005.text: Review a reply you formed, if you formed one. Did you keep the person's meaning and uncertainty intact? Did your response connect to the issue they raised? Pick one feature you would like to check next time.
L03.S07.c005.visualEn: Return to a full-screen review board; no model copied into the private space, no automatic chosen focus.
L03.S07.c005.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c005.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.c006.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c006.text: You do not have to paraphrase, ask, agree and add something in every turn. Listening helps you choose what is needed. Sometimes it is one precise question; sometimes it is a short confirmation; sometimes it is a relevant contribution of your own.
L03.S07.c006.visualEn: Show the four resources as separate optional tools rather than steps. No numbered formula or all-filled progress row.
L03.S07.c006.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c006.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.c007.speaker: coach
L03.S07.c007.text: This lesson ends here. You can revisit the examples or repeat the private rehearsal. Carry one check into the next discussion: before replying, be clear about which part of the other person's contribution you are responding to.
L03.S07.c007.visualEn: Neutral ending with user-controlled navigation. No next lesson launched, purchase gate, exam claim or achieved-learning certificate.
L03.S07.c007.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S07.c007.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S07.h101.purpose: Choose and rehearse one response privately.
L03.S07.h101.visualEn: Keep blank response area visible; no input, simulated recording or stored answer.

L03.S07.h102.visualEn: No system-selected focus, completion tick or score.

boundary: Use formal explanation and short examples. No perpetual three-person scene; no school, exam, policy or assessed-learner claim.
